scripts.login:claude: railway ssh --project "${RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID:?set RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID}" --environment "${RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID:?set RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID}" --service "${RAILWAY_SERVICE_ID:?set RAILWAY_SERVICE_ID}" -- sh -c 'umask 077; exec /CLIProxyAPI/CLIProxyAPI -config /CLIProxyAPI/config.yaml --claude-login --no-browser'
